interview.hardest_part: Navigating and surviving the later vertical regions, especially ALPINE/CALDERA, with precise first-person climbing, stamina management, and item use over many consecutive correct actions.
interview.likely_failure: Falling or becoming downed on a difficult climb before reaching the next height or region milestone, likely during SHORE ascent or a later precise platforming section.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Simple held movement inputs, shared mouse aliases, cumulative same-expedition height milestones, and the ability to retry with two attempts favor making gradual progress.
interview.harmful_mechanics: First-person climbing precision, stamina/downed risk, menus and item management, the game continuing while I think, and long multi-region expeditions make consistent progress and full completion very unlikely.
